title: Stop sending the default temperature in Anthropic#chat (400 on current Claude models)

files.patch:
@@ -10,6 +10,7 @@
 - [SECURITY]: A change which fixes a security vulnerability.
 
 ## [Unreleased]
+- [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1055] Stop sending the default `temperature` (0.0) from `Langchain::LLM::Anthropic#chat`; Claude Opus 4.7+ and Sonnet 5+ reject it with a 400. A temperature set in `default_options` or passed to `#chat` is still sent.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1052] Return every `tool_use` block from `AnthropicResponse#tool_calls` instead of only the first, so parallel tool calls from Claude are no longer silently dropped.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1051] Skip unsupported and non-file directory entries when loading a directory instead of returning an `UnknownFormatError` object into the results array.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1050] Return `[]` from `#tool_calls` on `OpenAIResponse`, `MistralAIResponse` and `GoogleGeminiResponse` when the response has no usable choices, instead of raising `NoMethodError`.

@@ -31,7 +31,10 @@ def initialize(api_key:, llm_options: {}, default_options: {})
       @defaults = DEFAULTS.merge(default_options)
       chat_parameters.update(
         model: {default: @defaults[:chat_model]},
-        temperature: {default: @defaults[:temperature]},
+        # Only a temperature the caller set is sent: Claude Opus 4.7 and later reject `temperature`,
+        # and Claude Sonnet 5 and later reject non-default values, so DEFAULTS[:temperature] would
+        # make every chat request with a current model fail with a 400.
+        temperature: {default: default_options[:temperature]},
         max_tokens: {default: @defaults[:max_tokens]},
         metadata: {},
         system: {},

@@ -80,13 +80,39 @@
     let(:fixture) { File.read("spec/fixtures/llm/anthropic/chat.json") }
     let(:response) { JSON.parse(fixture, symbolize_names: true) }
 
+    context "with temperature" do
+      it "does not send the library's default temperature, which current Claude models reject" do
+        expect(subject.client.messages).to receive(:create)
+          .with(hash_excluding(:temperature))
+          .and_return(response)
+
+        subject.chat(messages: messages)
+      end
+
+      it "sends a temperature set in default_options" do
+        llm = described_class.new(api_key: "123", default_options: {temperature: 0.2})
+        expect(llm.client.messages).to receive(:create)
+          .with(hash_including(temperature: 0.2))
+          .and_return(response)
+
+        llm.chat(messages: messages)
+      end
+
+      it "sends a temperature passed to #chat" do
+        expect(subject.client.messages).to receive(:create)
+          .with(hash_including(temperature: 0.7))
+          .and_return(response)
+
+        subject.chat(messages: messages, temperature: 0.7)
+      end
+    end
+
     context "with no additional parameters" do
       before do
         allow(subject.client.messages).to receive(:create)
           .with({
             model: described_class::DEFAULTS[:chat_model],
             messages: messages,
-            temperature: described_class::DEFAULTS[:temperature],
             max_tokens: described_class::DEFAULTS[:max_tokens],
             stop_sequences: ["beep"]
           })
